tagline: Desktop app to run several AI coding agents side by side, each in its own worktree
what: Runs Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode or Pi in parallel
Each agent works in its own isolated git worktree
Phone app to watch and steer agents remotely
read: A strong pick if you already juggle several coding agents at once

tagline: Turns existing desktop software into command-line tools that AI agents can drive
what: Generates a CLI harness for an app: GIS, video editors, game engines, notes
A hub to browse and install community-built CLIs
Agents get structured commands instead of clicking a GUI
read: A practical bridge between agents and everyday software. Quality varies by harness.

tagline: A job-hunt framework built on Claude Code: score postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews
what: Scores each job posting against your profile
Drafts a tailored CV and cover letter, then a reviewer agent critiques them
Builds interview prep from the role
read: Its author used it to get hired. Portal search is Denmark-only; swap in your own job boards.

tagline: Long-term memory for AI agents that learns from experience, not just recalls chat history
what: Retain, recall and reflect on memories
Merges facts into evidence-backed beliefs
Isolated memory banks, no cross-leaks
read: A serious take on agent memory: it builds beliefs from evidence, not just a log.

tagline: An MCP server that keeps raw tool output out of your AI coding agent's context window
what: Sandboxes tool output: 315 KB down to 5.4 KB
Tracks edits and tasks in SQLite across compaction
Agent writes scripts instead of reading 50 files
read: A practical fix for context bloat. Source-available (ELv2), not OSI open source.

tagline: A fully local voice studio: cloning, dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobooks
what: 16 text-to-speech + 11 speech-to-text engines
646-language catalogue, quality varies by engine
Local REST API, OpenAI-style audio routes, MCP
read: Bundles existing speech engines in one local app. Still beta, so expect rough edges.

tagline: A plugin that gives AI agents CAD skills: describe a part, get a 3D model.
what: Exports STEP, GLB, STL and 3MF files
Design-for-manufacturing checks and drawings
Links to 3D printing and CNC services
read: Handy for quick parts; usage stats are on by default, so check telemetry.

tagline: Open-source framework that turns HTML, CSS and animations into MP4 videos, built for AI agents.
what: Renders HTML, CSS and media to MP4 video
Ships 21 skills for AI coding agents
CLI to preview, lint and render locally
read: Video as code suits agents well; start with short clips.
